quote: All Travelers carrying controlled medication into the UAE must apply for approval through the Ministry of Health (MoH) website.
conditions: Apply for approval through the UAE Ministry of Health website before the trip and carry the prescription.
pageExcerpt: All Travelers carrying controlled medication into the UAE must apply for approval through the Ministry of Health (MoH) website. This should be completed before making the trip.
authority: Embassy of the United Arab Emirates, Washington DC

quote: All other medication (prescription for uncontrolled medication and over-the-counter medication) does not need prior approval from MoH.
conditions: No prior approval needed for uncontrolled or over-the-counter medicine.
pageExcerpt: All other medication (prescription for uncontrolled medication and over-the-counter medication) does not need prior approval from MoH.
authority: Embassy of the United Arab Emirates, Washington DC

quote: If your medicine is in “Narcotics” and/or “Stimulants' Raw Materials”, you need to get a permission before you enter/leave Japan.
conditions: Get permission before entering Japan (Stimulants' Raw Materials).
pageExcerpt: If your medicine is in “Narcotics” and/or “Stimulants' Raw Materials”, you need to get a permission before you enter/leave Japan.
authority: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Narcotics Control Department
